_comment: Edit this file directly to control exactly what the assistant is willing to reveal in drafted replies. Nothing outside this file + content_library.json is ever used as a source of facts about you.

current_role.title: Software Engineer
current_role.note: Client-facing API integration, internal tooling, agentic AI automation. Referenced generically as 'my current role' unless the recruiter is clearly already past an initial screen -- don't volunteer the employer name in a first-contact reply unless asked directly.

availability.start_date_flexibility: Can discuss a specific start date once an offer is on the table
availability.interview_availability: Weekday evenings and most weekday daytime hours with notice -- offer 2-3 concrete windows when asked, don't just say 'flexible'

compensation.flexibility: Will move depending on total comp / benefits / equity
compensation.note: Only state the $145k target if directly asked for a number or range. If asked 'what are you currently making' or for salary history, don't disclose -- redirect to target comp instead.

summary_for_replies: 6+ years of software engineering experience spanning JPMorgan Chase (release management, AI-directed deployment automation) and Highway (client-facing API integration, internal tooling, agentic AI workflows). Recent focus has been building and shipping real agentic AI systems -- tool-using pipelines, confidence-gated automation, eval harnesses -- both professionally and in a series of side projects.
never_reveal: Exact home street address -- city/state only
References -- offer to provide upon request at a later stage, don't include contact info for references unprompted
Prior salary / salary history at any past employer
Anything about ongoing or recent interview processes with other companies -- don't name other employers currently interviewing you
reply_tone: Professional, warm, concise. Thank the sender, directly answer what they asked, attach the resume, offer to schedule a call. Avoid corporate filler ('I am writing to express my interest...'). Sound like a real person replying to email, not a form letter.
